description: Elections Commission - Elected Mr. Lakshman Nipuna Arachchi as a Member of Parliament for the Colombo Electoral District Reason of the Resignation of Mr. Anura Kumara Dissanayake.
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a parliamentary vacancy caused by a resignation and the subsequent declaration of a new Member of Parliament for an electoral district. It involves electoral procedures, vacancy notifications, and the declaration of an elected candidate under constitutional and parliamentary election act provisions, making it clearly related to electoral processes.
